let value = controller.value();
let text = value.text.as_str();
fix: `controller.value()` clones the whole TextEditingValue (including the full text String) on every text key event. The clone exists only to avoid holding the controller's RefCell borrow while the intent mutates the controller. Compute the target offset/selection inside `controller.with_value(|value| ...)` (which returns only a usize or TextSelection) and call the mutating controller method after the closure returns. Only the Transpose branch, which needs the text bytes, should read `value.text` in its own `with_value` call.

`controller.text()` allocates a copy of the whole field text only to read its length. Replace with the borrow-based accessor: `(controller.with_value(|value| value.text.len()), TextAffinity::Upstream)`.

`selectable_text_editing_value` (crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/text.rs:944) returns an owned `String` cloned from the widget's text via `selectable_text_value` (text.rs:1152), so every arrow/shift key press on a SelectableText copies the whole text. Return a borrow or a shared handle instead (for example `Arc<str>` stored on the widget kind, or a `with_selectable_text_editing_value(label, |text, selection, foreign| ...)` callback), and compute `next` inside that scope. Needs the tree-side change in incular-widgets as well.
Replace with `#[expect(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "the line-boundary query needs the caret offset, affinity, direction, wrap flag and obscured state")]`.
